TitleAustralian Company Number (ACN)

Definition

An Australian Company Number (ACN) is allocated by the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) when a body becomes registered as a company under Corporations Law. Changes to this naming system are managed by the Australian HL7 Affiliate (HL7 Australia).
